svg.title: Code-block Recall@5 on four retrieval routes
svg.desc: Dot plot of code-block Recall@5 on 100 CodeNib Base issues, by retrieval route: with no reranker, with Qwen3-Reranker-4B, with Jev 1.13, and the candidate coverage that no reranker can exceed. BM25 top 100: 28.78%, 58.30%, 59.35%, coverage 63.78%. Dense, CodeRankEmbed with FAISS: 39.75%, 63.40%, 63.05%, coverage 71.98%. Hybrid, BM25 with dense through RRF: 32.02%, 65.03%, 67.92%, coverage 75.28%. Model-planned grep, 17.47 chunks on average: 58.62%, 68.07%, 71.40%, coverage 75.83%.
svg.text: Code-block Recall@5 on four retrieval routes
Candidate coverage, the ceiling for reranking
100 CodeNib Base issues, labels aligned to base_commit. Each route keeps at most 100 candidates; coverage counts targets anywhere in the pool.
